grammar_concept.title: Present Continuous: am/is/are + verb-ing
grammar_concept.rule: Use the Present Continuous (am/is/are + verb-ing) for actions happening right now, or temporary situations around the present time.
grammar_concept.simple_explanation: This tense is for things happening at this exact moment, or for a limited period around now — not for habits or routines, which use the Present Simple instead.
grammar_concept.example: I am reading a book right now. She is working from home this week.
grammar_concept.example_translation: Estou a ler um livro agora mesmo. Ela está a trabalhar a partir de casa esta semana.
grammar_concept.common_mistake_pt: Falantes de português tendem a esquecer o verbo "to be" (am/is/are), porque em português basta "estar a" + infinitivo: dizem "I reading" ou "I work now" em vez de "I am reading" — o inglês precisa sempre do auxiliar "to be" nesta estrutura, mesmo em frases curtas.
grammar_concept.correction: Nunca omitir am/is/are: "I am reading" (não "I reading"), "she is working" (não "she working"). Para uma ação a acontecer neste preciso momento, o Present Simple sozinho ("I work") normalmente soa errado ou incompleto.
grammar_concept.real_world_example: Numa chamada de trabalho: "Sorry, I can't talk now — I'm finishing a report."

example_sentences: I'm busy right now, can I call you back?

vocabulary.definition_en: now, during this period of time
example_sentences: We're renovating the kitchen at the moment.
She is currently living in Lisbon.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: Look! It ___ (rain) again.
exercises.explanation: Uma ação a acontecer neste momento ("Look!") pede o Present Continuous: is + verbo-ing.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Usar o Present Simple ("rains") para uma ação momentânea é um erro comum de transferência do português.

correct_answer: She is working from home this week.
distractors: She working from home this week.
She work from home this week.
She is work from home this week.
exercises.explanation: Precisa do auxiliar "is" antes do verbo com -ing: "is working", nunca só "working" ou "is work".
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Omitir "is"/"am"/"are" é o erro mais comum nesta estrutura para falantes de português.

correct_answer: now, during this period of time
exercises.explanation: "At the moment" refere-se ao presente, a este período de tempo em concreto.

exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio. What is Tom doing right now?
exercises.explanation: No áudio, ouve-se: "Tom is cooking dinner at the moment — he's making pasta for his family."
exercises.transcript: Tom is cooking dinner at the moment — he's making pasta for his family.

exercises.prompt: Read the text: "Maria is studying English this year. Right now, she is doing her homework at the kitchen table." What is Maria doing right now?
exercises.explanation: O texto indica diretamente: "she is doing her homework".

exercises.prompt: Translate to English: "Não posso falar agora — estou a trabalhar num projeto importante."
correct_answer: I can't talk now — I'm working on an important project.
I can't talk right now — I'm working on an important project.
exercises.explanation: Atenção ao "am" (contraído em "I'm") antes de "working" — não pode ser omitido.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Traduzir "estou a trabalhar" sem o "am" ("I working") é o erro mais comum nesta frase.

steps.content: "am" almost always contracts in speech: "I am" → "I'm" /aɪm/. The -ing ending is pronounced /ɪŋ/ in careful speech, but often softens to /ɪn/ in fast, casual conversation (e.g. "workin'").

steps.prompt: Look around you and describe 3 things that are happening right now, using the Present Continuous.
Write 5 sentences about what you and the people around you are doing at the moment.
